next.reason: 1985: 'When reference is to be made to the sum counter in the Procedure Division or Report Section.'; 2023: 'as a qualifier for a SUM counter, in the UPON phrase of the SUM clause, or as an operand in a SUM clause. The data-name shall not be referenced in any other way.'. Same subject, but 2023's list omits naming a sum counter for Procedure Division reference. It also adds a ban on any other reference to the data-name, which 1985 did not state.
